findings.claim: The proposed G6 harness (extend domain_sync.rs with one headless-preset node and one desktop-preset node) cannot produce the evidence Goal 6 and the integration-only policy require, and the analysis overstates what that baseline already proves.
findings.evidence: domain_sync.rs:113-121 'A real iroh endpoint bind, but never .start()ed — no actual gossip join or network I/O beyond the local socket bind'; :183-185 envelopes are handed to node B's handler by function call in one test process. One of the four tests is not two-node. Goal 6 requires two-node runs through production entry points; CLAUDE.md requires real process/network boundaries. §2.9 also conflicts with local-only validation ('in CI').
findings.suggested_fix: Reclassify domain_sync.rs as a library-level regression; build_required must specify a harness launching two real node processes via production entry points with address lookup, gossip join, a signed command over the wire, and the prometheus CLI transport chain, run locally.

findings.claim: The analysis asserts the MCP surface survives re-hosting but sovereign-sync's MCP is stdio-only and served by the binary option A removes; nothing covers how AI clients reach an in-process Tauri-hosted node.
findings.evidence: main.rs:11 'MCP server over stdio'; serve_stdio; install-skills-flat.sh:541-552 registers sovereign-sync --mode mcp in mcp-servers.json; Companion spec §4.1 says stdio MCPs remain stdio because the AI client spawns them; no stdio bridge in the service table or build_required.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an explicit disposition: a thin sovereign-sync --mode mcp stdio shim proxying to the node's Unix socket, or drop MCP mode and update the installer and sync-* skills; record in build_required and the G5 footprint.

findings.claim: Keychain-continuity mechanism misdescribed: keyring 3.6.3 macOS backend uses the legacy login keychain with a per-item ACL prompt; the failing direction is the headless node, and access groups are unavailable to an unbundled launchd binary.
